source.title: Effects of Dapagliflozin on 24-Hour Glycemic Control in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes: A Randomized Controlled Trial

duplicate_review.notes: No duplicate atoms detected across semantic batches.

consistency_findings: The source explicitly states that the overall study, not individual metformin/insulin strata, was powered for treatment-difference inference; subgroup and secondary P values are preserved as nominal.
Insulin dosing could change at investigator discretion and detailed insulin-dose data were not collected, complicating interpretation of the insulin-stratum efficacy signal.
The source package in Drive contained supplements only; the exact DOI/PMID/PMCID-matched open-access primary article was used for whole-source extraction.
schema_gaps: The schema has no dedicated field for multiplicity status or nominal versus confirmatory P values; this is preserved in tags and canonical statements.
The schema has no dedicated study-level metadata object; source metadata is carried outside the atom array and publication identity is shared by UUID.
extraction_limitations: Main-article PDF screenshots were requested during source review but the web screenshot endpoint returned cache-miss errors; figures and tables were reconciled from the parsed primary PDF text/captions and the supplied supplementary PDFs.
No unsupported study details were invented; appraisal-derived limitations are explicitly marked assertion_origin=extractor_inference.
